name: inkscape-lower-third-layers
story: A student-TV volunteer drew a 1920x1080 lower third on two layers (Palkki, Copy), labelled the name and role objects in Object Properties, left the strap unlabelled, and saved with File > Save As... > Inkscape SVG.
idioms: xmlns:sodipodi and xmlns:inkscape declared on <svg> alongside a redundant xmlns:svg
<sodipodi:namedview> carrying window geometry, zoom, deskcolor and inkscape:current-layer
empty <defs id="defs1" /> and an rdf/cc/dc <metadata> block
serial ids: text123 / text847 / tspan846 / rect234
typography entirely in style="" (font-size:56px;font-family:Archivo;-inkscape-font-specification:'Archivo Bold'), zero presentation attributes
xml:space="preserve" on every <text>, with <tspan sodipodi:role="line"> repeating the parent's x/y and no whitespace between the tags
one attribute per line at a 3-space continuation indent, self-closing tags written as ' />'
ry="8" instead of rx on the rounded panel
sodipodi:docname with a non-ASCII-ish local filename (alatekstipalkki.svg)
whyThisMatters: If the importer reads only Illustrator-style id/data-name it will miss inkscape:label entirely and offer three fields called text123, text455 and text847; and if it treats the sodipodi:role="line" tspan as a separate positioned line it will hand the operator six fields for three lines of copy.
